name: 1328-logprobs-llama7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 20% and cooldown 10% by request count, bounded at 2000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. 256 is this engine's own max-num-seqs, so the resident batch sits at its ceiling.
workload: 2000 ShareGPT conversations, drawn by the era driver's own sampler (random.seed(0); keep >= 2 turns; drop rows with prompt < 4, reply < 4, prompt > 1024 or prompt+reply > 2048; then random.sample over the whole filtered corpus) and materialised by configs/data/make-dataset.py into configs/data/sharegpt-2000-llama7b.jsonl: 479893 prompt tokens (mean 240, p90 690, max 1024) and 487783 output tokens (mean 244, p90 610, max 1850). Sampling is n=1, temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, ignore_eos true, max_tokens = the conversation's own reply length, and logprobs 5 on every request.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter chat assistant returning top-five token alternatives with each reply, handling 256 concurrent conversations on one GPU.
launch:
# October 2023 vLLM: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, not a warning.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM -- there is no chunked prefill, no prefix caching, no CUDA
# graphs, no enforce_eager, no max_seq_len_to_capture, no kv-cache-dtype and no V1 engine.
#
# Flat `key: value` only. A value beginning `{` or `[` is read as JSON and must stay on ONE line;
# an indented YAML block is silently skipped and never reaches the engine args.

model: huggyllama/llama-7b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own `torch_dtype: float16`; `half` and `float16` map to the same torch dtype.
dtype: half

# The checkpoint's own `max_position_embeddings`, and this engine's default when the key is absent.
max-model-len: 2048

# This engine's own resolved defaults, written out because the literals move across this era.
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0

# Every key not written above is left at this engine's default.
